caption: The drawing features a central red five-pointed star set within a large cream-colored circle. Surrounding the circle is a ring of alternating red and cream triangles, creating a sunburst or radiating effect. The corners of the rectangular composition each contain curved triangular shapes filled with a muted teal green color. The entire design is composed of geometric forms, with straight lines and sharp angles, mainly in red, cream, and teal green. The pattern is symmetric and fills the majority of the composition, with the background and all sections of the design clearly delineated by color. There are visible hand-drawn textures and slight irregularities in the coloring.
title: Star & Ring Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
